Lemma
[The Unnormalized Vectors Reproduce the Flag]

↗ prop:gram-schmidt-bilin-spec

With the same hypotheses, \[ \operatorname {span}(u_1,\ldots ,u_j)=\operatorname {span}(v_1,\ldots ,v_j) \qquad (j\leq n). \]

Proof

↗ prop:gram-schmidt-bilin-spec \sketch Take $k=n$ in part (c) of Proposition 16.1.

□
